brief_rationale: The model completed all responsibility-chain items without serious error and demonstrated meaningful high-order performance through caregiver-adapted communication (HO1), real-world navigation of family conflict (HO2), and structured verification workflow (HO3). Two high-order points were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact, meeting Strong criteria but not Perfect due to HO4 not being distinctly completed beyond RC requirements. All dimensions achieved good or excellent ratings with safe, executable, traceable closure.

closure_assessment.explanation: Closure provides specific next actions (anesthesia clinic appointment with materials to bring), clear home observation thresholds (lips/face purple, frequent nighttime choking ≥3/night, daytime sleepiness or breathing difficulty → emergency), and practical feeding guidance.
